I don't have Nike's reported results for fiscal Q4 2026 (the quarter ending May 31, 2026), so this is an estimate rather than a reported figure: roughly $6.6 billion in cost of sales.

The estimate rests on my recollection of recent quarters:

- **Fiscal Q4 2025:** revenue was about $11.1 billion at a gross margin of about 40.3%, implying cost of sales of about $6.63 billion.
- **Fiscal 2026 so far:** cost of sales was about $6.8 billion in Q1 and about $7.4 billion in Q2, with gross margins in the 40–42% range.

Assuming Q4 2026 revenue of roughly $11.1–11.3 billion and a gross margin near 41%, cost of sales comes out at about $6.6 billion. Note also that Nike does not file a 10-Q for Q4, so the actual figure would be derived as the full-year 10-K amount minus the nine-month amount.
